messages:
Liz: Quick sync — trying to onboard sage-mini-quant weights. We have weights at gs://redwood-weights/sage-mini/v2/quant/ and tokenizer file that uses <s> and </s> as BOS/EOS but the model appears to expect sentinel control chars on first pass. Anyone seen this mismatch?
Tom: I pulled the weights and ran a dry-start. Tokenizer mapping shows special_tokens: {\"bos_token\":\"<s>\",\"eos_token\":\"</s>\",\"unk_token\":\"<unk>\"} but embed offsets shift by 1 in chat templates.
Reena: @Liz can you paste the tokenizer header? quick grep of the json would help.
Liz: here's the top-level of tokenizer.json that shipped with weights:
```json
{"special_tokens_map": {"bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>", "additional_special_tokens": ["<|user|>", "<|assistant|>"]}}
```
Tom: that's the problem — our chat templates insert `<|assistant|>` as role delim but runtime expects ASCII control sentinels for fastpath caching. Off-by-one in KV cache evictions.
Sam: Thinking out loud: we can either (a) map those additional tokens to sentinels at load-time, or (b) adjust chatfmt to prefer bos/eos string tokens. (a) is lower-latency fix.
Jordan: +1 for mapping at load-time. Add a config flag so Private deployments can opt out.
Maya: I can add a runtime shim. Proposed config snippet:
```yaml
serve:
  tokenizer_overrides:
    map_additional_to_control: true
    control_bos: "\\u0002"
    control_eos: "\\u0003"
```

I'll open a PR after I run local smoke.
DeployBot: CI check started for branch tokenizer-shim (build #8934).
Tom: also note: weights path needs a checksum in model manifest. Liz can you confirm SHA256?
Liz: sha256: aa3f4b7c2dbe9f1ee6c8a5f7b4f9c3e2a1b0c9d8e7f6a5b4c3d2e1f0a9b8c7d6 — I uploaded it to gs://redwood-weights/sage-mini/v2/quant/manifest.json
Reena: I'll validate manifest vs GCS and run tokenizer unit test suite.
Sam: If tests pass, can we canary on dedicated region us-west-2 with traffic cap 5rps?
Jordan: schedule looks good. @Maya ping me when PR is ready; I'll do CR + canary deploy.
Liz: thanks all — action items: Maya add shim PR, Reena run validation, Jordan CR + deploy, Tom double-check cache eviction policy. I'll update the model onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:
